summary: fix(settings): read pairing state when v2 supplicant ApproveSignIn mounts
description:
Because:

- In v2 pairing, a fast authority approval sets the supplicant state to
  Complete before ApproveSignIn subscribes, so the page stays on approve_signin.

This commit:

- Routes Complete or Failed from integration.state when ApproveSignIn mounts.
- Adds tests for each state at mount.

Closes FXA-14793
